repeats.readback: none. paintSignal is a synchronous 2D-canvas sample plus opacity/filter, or engine.stats() generation/lastFrameMs on the GPU path.

gate.rule: When the path is on: each control paints in the event task or the next frame, and the change makes zero network requests. A control that does not move the signal is not a late paint. Sun-on-aspect is expected to be inert.

repeats.pattern: 10 by 10 lawnmower, 0.004° lat by 0.006° lng, zoom 15, 120 ms between moves.
repeats.budgetNote: Spec default fine-pointer texture budget, 192 MB. Coarse-pointer default is 64 MB. This machine is measured against 192 MB.

engine.coverageKind: resident tile overlap estimate; readProvenance returns sampled pixel coverage

gate.rule: When the path is on: engine texture bytes stay within 192 MB, canvas count does not grow by more than 2 over the stress, and JS heap stays within 35% plus 8 MB of the start sample. WebKit often has no heap figure; heapPass is then null.

repeats.coverageMethod: playwright-screenshot of a center clip, separate pass from the rAF timer. Not every composited frame. Not drawImage of the WebGL canvas.

gate.rule: When the path is on: p95 rAF <= 16.7 ms Chrome or <= 20 ms WebKit, and no sampled frame below 98% coverage once an ancestor is resident.
